notes.title: Versus Evil Hidden Gems Sale Going on Now!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Versus Evil will be celebrating its 10-year anniversary this year! We've published many games over the past decade, so today we'd like to shine a light on several hidden gems from our vast catalog.

First up is Antihero, a fast-paced digital board game with an (Oliver) Twist. Recruit street urchins, hire thugs, start a gang, upgrade your guild, steal everything... and bribe, blackmail, and assassinate your way to victory.

Next is Let Them Come, a fast-paced pixel art shoot 'em up. Twitchy trigger fingers and focused battle tactics are the order of the day as wave after wave of alien-like creatures try to take you down.

Then there's Cardpocalypse, where you make friends, play cards, twist the rules, become a Mega Mutant Power Pets master, and try to save the world in this single-player RPG about being a 90's kid.

In Yaga, play as Ivan, a one-handed blacksmith with incredibly bad luck, who must take on the impossible tasks given to him by the tzar. All the while the mysterious witch, Baba Yaga, watches over Ivan's fate.

Our second-to-last spotlight is for Faeria, a strategy game like no other. Build exciting decks and shape the battlefield as you fight epic battles. Raise mountains, build forests, fill lakes, or harness the sands of the deserts. You choose your own path to victory.

Finally, there's MOTHERGUNSHIP, a bullet-hell FPS where you craft your own guns, fight gigantic bosses, and defeat a robotic alien armada that conquered Earth. Face off against overwhelming odds in brutal, non-stop combats where thinking on your feet is the only way to survive.

If any of these titles sound enticing, they're on sale for a limited time until March 6th, so don't wait!

notes.title: Available Now - The Roots of Evil (DLC)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33165295/e4274ba5eb62d326ef151d9ca37f2076de16b80b.jpg[/img]

Just in time for Halloween, Ivan faces an all new challenge in the spooky Corrupted Forest, filled with new corrupted creatures and boss fights! 

The Roots of Evil DLC adds a new chapter to Ivan's story centered around Oakvale, a village under siege by all these corrupted baddies. The villagers suspect the forest spirit Leshy is behind the attacks, but not everyone is so sure. Which side will you choose?

The DLC also adds new side quests, new choices, a new Pickaxe tool, and new characters to meet along the way. Prepare yourself for a challenging adventure ahead!

In the spirit of Halloween, we've also added new monsters to the base game: the Spider Mother and Spiderlings. For our arachnophobic friends, don't worry. We see you! We've included an option to replace them with the mythical Goat Mother and Goat Kids.

Good luck! Ivan will need it.

notes.title: Versus Evil 8th Anniversary Sale Going on Now!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Versus Evil is turning 8! Can you believe it? Well, believe it because to celebrate we're having a sale on our awesome [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/VersusEvil]catalog[/url] of games!

Over these past 8 years, we've had the opportunity to help put out many fun and creative games. This year saw the release of Jumpala, Hitchhiker - A Mystery Game, and Sockventure, as well as Early Access releases for First Class Trouble, Almighty: Kill Your Gods, and The Hand of Merlin. Tomorrow sees the release of our latest addition, UnMetal!

UnMetal is a 2D stealth action-adventure that pays homage to the classics with a healthy dose of humor and satire. You play as Jesse Fox, who is definitely NOT an elite commando, under arrest for a crime he didn't commit, and must escape a covert military base using his wits and fists.

Sounds like fun, right? Check out UnMetal and the rest of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/VersusEvil]catalog[/url] for anything that may interest you!

To close, some thanks are in order...

Thank you to our developers who really give it their all to bring these games to life.

Thank you to our Heralds who are the best ambassadors we could ever hope for.

And, of course, thank you to our players who are the reason we continue to strive to put out the best games we possibly can. This has been one long, crazy journey, and we're glad you're all on it with us.

From all of us at Versus Evil, thank you for making these past 8 years great. Now, go score some deals!

notes.title: Yaga: "Which hand is it?" Update
notes.notes:
While playing Yaga, you may have noticed some inconsistency between which hand is actually the one that Ivan the Blacksmith lost when running away from Likho. This was initially a technical decision, to reduce the number of animations that our artists have to create. Lots of games mirror the character animations, but often this is not noticed because their characters are symetrical, unlike Ivan, where the flipping is much more obvious. For a while, we rationalized it by blaming the "unreliable narrator" of the game. In oral storytelling, details like this sometimes get mixed, so we thougt it was a fun explanation for it. 

However, the feedback we got from the community gave us a hand in prioritizing this for an update. We always want to believe the great feedback from our community is in good hands, so after discussing it shortly, we had a show of hands and decided to get our hands dirty and fix it. Our animator took matters in his own hands and decided to give it a shot and see how fast he can create the set of animations needed.

We would have implemented this sooner if we didn't have our hands full with bugfixes, balancing and additional content. Good thing we fixed this issue before it got out of hand.

Hands down, this is NOT our most significant update, but we believe it will come in handy for all of our players. On the other hand, we also added a few additional tweaks and improvements:

[list]
[*]You can now find pre-crafted hammers with interesting enhancements combinations on them during levels, (inside treasure chests). This allows you to experiment with them, give you ideas for crafting, and also is a new source for ores and ehnancements.
[*]Added more anvils inside levels, to make sure you have the opportunity to forge new hammers during levels.
[*]Tweaked timings for various Ivan animations (Charged Melee, Bearpaw Attack, Melee Combos, and others), to make him more responsive
[*]Stun enemies when touching them while moving underground with the shovel.
[*]Make some enemies "turn" more slowly, so they give you more opportunity to attack from behind
[*]Added some cinematic slow-motion when encountering boss fights.
[/list]

We now hand over this update to you, hoping that the hand-switching issues it not that obvious anymore. 

Fingers crossed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33165295/a0ab84899fa8a635c0caf393af626fde4d946281.png[/img]

notes.title: Yaga v1.2.34 Hotfixes
notes.notes:
We've just pushed an important update that fixes most major issues reported this week. The fixes include:

[list]
[*]Added options for VSync and FPS Locking to prevent issues on high-refresh rate displays.
[*]Fixed issues where enemies dropped by a Striga would get into an "unkillable" state and block progress.
[*]Fixed issues with Bees spawning outside of the combat area.
[*]Made it possible for a Righteous Ivan to go against his personality at the ending.
[*]Enabled Minimap in the Village
[*]Set Minimap to always be visible.
[*]Destroyed ovens can now be repaired next time you meet them.
[*]Ovens can no longer be destroyed after being repaired.
[*]Fixed some issues with Blessings given by a Priest.
[*]Fixed issues with camera sometimes remaining zoomed-in
[*]Fixed in issue with matchmaking two delicate beasts in the Farmlands
[*]Softened up Bad Luck Strikes that did some bad things to you based on your personality
[*]You can now also multiply Enhancements at Witches (Magic -> Give Item) (Actually, this is only coming tomorrow in v1.2.35 due to a last-minute memory loss by me, but it will be there. Totally promise!)
[/list]

Have fun playing Yaga!
